description_en: Adds a routing algorithm to a logical table
description_zh: 为逻辑表添加路由算法配置
name: AddLogicTableRouteConfig

parameters.help_en: The ID of the logical table. You can call the [ListLogicTables](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/data-management-service/latest/listlogictables) operation to query the ID of the logical table
parameters.help_zh: 逻辑库的表ID，可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141875.html获取该参数的值
parameters.name: table_id

parameters.help_en:
The unique key of the routing algorithm. 

> - You can create a custom unique key for the routing algorithm. No requirements are imposed on custom unique keys.
> - The unique key of the routing algorithm in the same logical table must be unique
parameters.help_zh:
路由算法唯一键。

> - 您可以自定义路由算法唯一键，无任何约束格式。
> - 同一个逻辑表下的路由算法配置唯一键不能重复
parameters.name: route_key

parameters.help_en: The routing algorithm expression. For more information about how to configure a routing algorithm expression, see [Configure a routing algorithm](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/data-management-service/latest/configure-a-routing-algorithm)
parameters.help_zh: 路由算法表达式，您可以参考DMS的文档配置路由算法表达式，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/107594.html
parameters.name: route_expr

parameters.help_en: The ID of the tenant. You can call the [GetUserActiveTenant](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/data-management-service/latest/getuseractivetenant) operation to query the tenant ID
parameters.help_zh: 租户ID，可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198073.html获取该参数的值
parameters.name: tid
